test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 13 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

To keep an eye on

options.text: To be able to understand everything
To see someone in a bad light

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'** i.e. **'To watch over closely'.**
